policy: Union of named old/new parents with actual shadows, furniture edges, side art, exposed background and contract rim/plinth; uniformly black outer-frame interior is not a blanket allowed region. V2 also includes independently reviewed exact physical old wood-line boxes for both cheeks in every active case, each expanded by exactly one device pixel.
pixel_membership: Centers x+0.5,y+0.5 in each transformed logical rectangle expanded exactly one DEVICE pixel, then intersected with actual viewport/caller clip. No integer-enclosure half-pixel or logical-unit allowance.
inactive_policy: Whole-frame RGBA equality; empty permitted mask.

limits: An independent change-region test, not original-art equality or material correctness. Panel content/readability and live controls have separate literal native tests. Fixed copied states, SDL software surfaces, no physical display/device or audio claim. The original v1 failure remains immutable. The active whole-composition union protects very few unclipped pixels; exact inactive equality is a separate, stronger result.
